Jana Otzipka (born; 1 February 2005) is a Belgian tennis player. She has career-high rankings of No. 766 in singles, achieved in May 2025, and No. 506 in doubles, achieved in May 2025. In April 2025, played the biggest final of her career in Spain. She became the champion in doubles with her German partner Gina Marie Dittmann at the ITF W50 Yecla . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] She won the first championship of her career. With her title win, she reached a new career-high doubles ranking of No 506.
